scene: School activity table. A set of three stacking cups — big, middle and tiny — lies flat at table center. Teacher sits at screen-left; Child stands at screen-right; both can reach the cups. Locked 16:9 medium two-shot with both faces and the cups visible.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: A playful teacher-and-student reversal; Child guides with small polite gestures; Teacher follows with good-humored concentration; both end with warm praise and a small imaginary sticker moment.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.

clips.start: The three cups lie flat at table center; Teacher sits and Child stands with empty hands.
clips.action: Teacher opens her palms toward the cups. Child places the big cup upright at center with both hands; Teacher nods once and repeats the step.
clips.end: The big cup stands upright at center; both hands return.

clips.start: The big cup stands upright at center; both hands return to rest.
clips.action: Child points at the middle cup, small end up. Teacher picks it up and places it carefully; Child tilts one hand slightly while saying almost, guiding the small turn; Teacher adjusts the cup until the stripes line up.
clips.end: The middle cup sits on the big one with stripes aligned; Teacher keeps her hands near.

clips.start: The middle cup sits on the big one with stripes aligned; Teacher keeps her hands near.
clips.action: Child points at the tiny cup. Teacher places it on top and spreads her arms with a happy question face; Child claps once softly and presses an imaginary sticker onto the back of Teacher's hand with one thumb.
clips.end: The three cups stand stacked at center; Teacher rests her hand with the invisible sticker; both beam at the finished tower.
